name: Digital Knowledge Co., Ltd.
summary: Digital Knowledge Co., Ltd. provides e-learning solutions to educational and training institutions in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Education DX Business and Education Export Business. The Education DX business segment provides research, development, manufacturing, and sales of e-learning products, e-learning system customization, e-learning server operation, content production and sales, student recruitment support, operation outsourcing, and education and IT equipment. It also offers Educational DX license that provides optional modules for specific purposes, such as a second-tier video learning material creation and distribution service, web conferencing tool integration, automated student response, facial image authentication, and skill management systems, to the learning management system, and license operation and maintenance; and Education DX integration also consists of system design and development, server construction, teaching material production, and work agency services. In addition, It offers a variety of environments, including cloud environments, shared servers, and dedicated servers. The Education export business segment provides export services for Japanese education; and engages in operation of private universities overseas. The company serves educational businesses such as, schools, cram schools, correspondence courses, publishers, corporate training departments, and etc. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Taito, Japan.
